blockedIdentities.detail: Targeted discovery did not establish a manufacturer-owned source that uniquely matches the repository identity.
The short repository name resolves to multiple unrelated businesses and no zero-ambiguity manufacturer-owned source was established.

profiles.shortDescription: Blackmer is a PSG brand for industrial pumps and reciprocating gas compressors.
fullDescription: The official PSG brand page establishes Blackmer as a pump and compressor manufacturer within Dover.
Its documented portfolio includes sliding-vane, gear, centrifugal, regenerative-turbine and screw pumps together with reciprocating gas compressors.

profiles.shortDescription: Bran+Luebbe is an SPX FLOW brand for metering, process pumping, chemical injection and process analysis.
fullDescription: Official SPX FLOW material identifies Bran+Luebbe with precision metering and process equipment.
The documented range includes metering pumps, process diaphragm pumps, chemical-injection systems, analyzers and mixing systems.

profiles.shortDescription: General Kinematics develops vibratory and rotary equipment for processing and moving bulk materials.
fullDescription: The official General Kinematics site documents material-processing equipment for foundry, recycling, mining and bulk-handling operations.
Its product groups include vibratory feeders, conveyors, screens, cooling systems and rotary process equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Magnescale develops precision linear and angular measurement systems for industrial positioning and metrology.
fullDescription: Official Magnescale material documents magnetic and laser-based measurement technologies for machine positioning.
The portfolio includes linear scales, angle encoders, Laserscale systems and digital gauges.

profiles.shortDescription: Mueller Steam Specialty is a Watts brand for industrial strainers, valves and flow-system components.
fullDescription: The official Watts brand page establishes Mueller Steam Specialty within its industrial flow-control portfolio.
Documented products include basket, duplex, Y and tee strainers together with butterfly, check and control valves, line blinds and suction diffusers.

profiles.shortDescription: Richardson Electronics supplies engineered components and systems for RF, microwave, power-electronics and industrial display applications.
fullDescription: The official Richardson Electronics portfolio covers RF and microwave components, power-grid and microwave tubes, vacuum capacitors and power-electronic technologies.
First-party product material also documents CT and MRI tubes, industrial monitors and related engineered solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Timmer develops industrial pumps, pneumatic components and vacuum-lifting systems.
fullDescription: The official Timmer site structures its range around pumps, pneumatics and vacuum lifting.
Documented products include double-diaphragm, high-pressure diaphragm and piston pumps, pneumatic cylinders and vacuum-handling equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: URACA develops high-pressure plunger pumps, process pumps and engineered high-pressure cleaning systems.
fullDescription: The official URACA site documents plunger-pump technology for high-pressure and process applications.
Its portfolio also includes automated high-pressure cleaning systems, accessories and system-control solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Wilden is a PSG brand for air-operated and electrically operated double-diaphragm pumps.
fullDescription: The official PSG page records Wilden's development of the air-operated double-diaphragm pump in 1955.
The current portfolio includes Pro-Flo SHIFT and Pro-Flo pump platforms, specialty diaphragm pumps and surge dampeners.

profiles.shortDescription: BOMAR manufactures industrial band saws and complementary material-cutting equipment.
fullDescription: The official BOMAR product directory documents manual, semi-automatic and automatic band-saw machines.
Its published range also includes deburring machines, belt sanders and material-handling accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: 4B Braime develops components and monitoring systems for bucket elevators and bulk-material conveyors.
fullDescription: The official 4B site documents elevator buckets, bolts, belting and chain-conveyor components for bulk handling.
Its portfolio also includes speed, alignment, level and hazard-monitoring sensors and control systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Fireye develops flame-safeguard, burner-management and combustion-control equipment.
fullDescription: Official Fireye product material documents ultraviolet and infrared flame scanners, flame safeguards and burner-management controls.
The portfolio also includes igniters, pilots and combustion-efficiency controls for industrial firing systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Plenty is an SPX FLOW brand for industrial filtration and straining equipment.
fullDescription: The official SPX FLOW brand page establishes the Plenty identity within its process-equipment portfolio.
Its filtration range covers industrial strainers and filtration equipment for liquid-handling systems.

profiles.shortDescription: AHP Merkle develops hydraulic cylinders and electrohydraulic linear actuators for industrial machinery.
fullDescription: The official AHP Merkle site documents hydraulic-cylinder engineering since 1973.
Its product range includes block, standard and locking cylinders together with electrohydraulic linear actuators and cylinder accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: B&R develops industrial automation, control, visualization and motion-control technologies within the ABB Group.
fullDescription: The official B&R product directory covers control, monitoring, industrial computing, safety and motion technologies.
First-party ABB material identifies B&R as part of its machine-automation portfolio, including Automation Studio engineering software.

profiles.shortDescription: Baltimore Aircoil develops evaporative, dry and hybrid heat-rejection and thermal-storage equipment.
fullDescription: The official BAC product directory documents cooling towers, closed-circuit cooling towers, evaporative condensers and dry or adiabatic products.
The range also includes hybrid coolers, ice thermal storage and immersion-cooling systems.

profiles.shortDescription: ELGO Electronic develops magnetic measurement, position indication and positioning-control systems.
fullDescription: The official ELGO catalogue documents magnetic linear and rotary measurement systems.
Its product groups include position indicators, positioning controls and LIMAX shaft-information systems for lifts.

profiles.shortDescription: Filton manufactures rotary unions, swivel joints and associated fluid-transfer components.
fullDescription: The official Filton site documents rotary unions and swivel joints for transferring fluids into rotating or moving machinery.
Its range also includes air-breather filters and flexible hoses.

profiles.shortDescription: HEINZMANN develops engine and turbine management, fuel-injection and generator-control technologies.
fullDescription: Official HEINZMANN material documents analogue, digital and hydraulic speed governors together with actuators and sensors.
The portfolio also covers injection and common-rail systems, turbine controls and generator-management equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: M PUMPS manufactures sealless magnetic-drive and mechanically sealed process pumps.
fullDescription: The official company profile documents magnetic-drive and mechanical-seal pump technologies for process applications.
The range includes single- and multistage centrifugal pumps and positive-displacement pump families.

profiles.shortDescription: PEGAS-GONDA manufactures industrial band-saw machines and material-handling accessories.
fullDescription: The official catalogue documents joint, double-column, angle-cutting, bundle-cutting and high-efficiency band saws.
The product scope also includes circular saws, roller tables and handling systems for cut material.

profiles.shortDescription: SOFIMA is part of UFI Filters' hydraulic filtration portfolio for mobile and industrial systems.
fullDescription: The official UFI Hydraulics product directory retains the UFI and SOFIMA filtration brands.
Its documented range includes suction, pressure, return, offline, transmission and air filters, filter elements and clogging indicators.

profiles.shortDescription: Zander is a Parker brand for compressed-air and gas treatment equipment.
fullDescription: Official Parker material retains the Zander brand for compressed-air dryers, filters and related service components.
The documented portfolio includes adsorption and high-pressure dryers, compressed-air and gas filters, breathing-air purification and condensate-management technologies.

profiles.parentCompany: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Primetals Technologies group
profiles.shortDescription: ABP Induction develops induction furnaces and heating systems for metals processing.
fullDescription: The official ABP profile documents induction melting, pouring, holding and heating systems for ferrous and non-ferrous metals.
Its foundry portfolio includes coreless and channel induction furnaces together with digital service and control technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Bondioli & Pavesi develops mechanical power-transmission, hydraulic-control and heat-exchange components.
fullDescription: The official product directory covers drive shafts, gearboxes, clutches, hydraulic pumps and motors.
It also documents directional and cartridge valves, electronic control components, fan-drive systems and heat exchangers.

profiles.shortDescription: Clextral develops twin-screw extrusion systems and integrated process lines for food and industrial applications.
fullDescription: The official Clextral site documents co-rotating twin-screw extruders, preconditioners, dryers and ancillary production-line equipment.
Its process scope covers food and feed production as well as non-food extrusion, green industries and drying technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Dynisco develops melt-pressure sensors, instrumentation and analytical equipment for polymer processing.
fullDescription: The official Dynisco portfolio documents melt-pressure transducers and transmitters for extrusion and polymer-processing environments.
It also includes indicators, controls and polymer-testing or analytical instruments supported by first-party technical documentation.

profiles.shortDescription: Flender develops industrial gear units, couplings and associated drive-system components.
fullDescription: The official Flender product directory documents helical, bevel-helical and planetary gear units for industrial applications.
Its coupling portfolio covers flexible, torsionally rigid, hydrodynamic, backlash-free and railway configurations, with supporting drive components and documentation.

profiles.shortDescription: GIVI MISURE develops linear and rotary measurement and positioning systems for industrial machinery.
fullDescription: The official product directory documents optical scales, magnetic measurement systems and rotary encoders.
The range also includes digital readouts, position controllers and related accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Hankison develops compressed-air dryers, filters, purifiers and condensate-management equipment.
fullDescription: The official Hankison product directory covers refrigerated, desiccant and membrane compressed-air dryers.
Its portfolio also includes air filters, breathing-air purifiers and condensate-management systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Headline Filters manufactures filter elements, housings and separators for gases and liquids.
fullDescription: The official product directory covers filter elements and housings for compressed air, natural gas, high-purity gas and liquids.
It also documents disposable inline filters, adsorbers, membrane separators and sample-conditioning components.

profiles.shortDescription: Italvibras manufactures electric, mechanical and electromagnetic vibrators for industrial equipment.
fullDescription: The official product pages document foot-mounted and flange-mounted electric vibrators.
The range also includes high-frequency, mechanical and electromagnetic vibrators for industrial process equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: KNOLL develops conveyor, filtration and pump systems for machine tools and metalworking processes.
fullDescription: The official KNOLL site structures its portfolio around chip conveyors, coolant-filtration systems, automation and industrial pumps.
Documented pump families include screw-spindle, centrifugal, submersible and high-pressure configurations for machine-tool and process applications.
